lessons_used: Home wait_info changes are consistently helpful, winning 5 out of 10 tests.
Adoption redesigns are generally helpful, winning 3 out of 4 tests.
Choose_path updates (copy, layout, redesign) showed no positive effect, ranging from no clear effect to performing worse across multiple tests.
Finish hints, sign-in notifications, and sign-in redesigns showed no positive effect, frequently leading to negative impacts or early test stops.
Adoption hints, home redesigns, finish layouts, finish new flows, sign-in copy, and sign-in incentives showed no clear effect across 2 or 3 tests each.
Predictions were systematically too low for big winning changes and too high for changes with no clear effect or negative outcomes; single-test categories remain thin evidence.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Interactive Mini Activity Display
candidates.change: Displays interactive pet activity hints and progress mini-updates while desktop companion assets generate in the background.
candidates.why: Home wait_info tests consistently win (50% success rate), addressing the massive mean wait time of 2,336s on the waiting screen.

components.text: Your companion is preparing its desktop territory...

guard.reason: Adds interactive activity info to the waiting screen within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info features have a proven 50% win rate and address high mean wait time.

candidates.change: Redesign the companion selection screen into a full stage carousel with trait callouts and sound previews.
candidates.why: Adoption redesigns are highly effective in past tests (75% win rate), helping boost completion from the adoption funnel step.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a friend to keep you company on your desktop.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns are highly effective with a 75% win rate and +4.4% average historical lift.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready for Desktop Action
